## Epidemic phase

```{r}
raw = read.csv("Data/raw_data.csv")
```

```{r}
oracle <- raw %>%
  group_by(location, target_end_date) %>%
  slice_max(reference_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(location, target_end_date, oracle_value) %>%
  arrange(location, target_end_date)

trend_df <- oracle %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  mutate(
    MA3        = rollmean(oracle_value, k = 3, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    pct_change = (MA3 - lag(MA3)) / lag(MA3) * 100,
    trend = case_when(
      pct_change > 5  ~ "Increasing",
      pct_change < -5 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE            ~ "Stable"
    ),
    trend = factor(trend, levels = c("Decreasing", "Stable", "Increasing"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(location, target_end_date, trend)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))
nrow(standard_wis) 

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))
nrow(standard_wis) 
```

# Models

We write log_raw_normal_identity = LRNI, log_log_normal_identity = LLRI, none_raw_tweedie_log = NRTL
none_raw_gamma_log = NRGL

## LRNI
```{r}
length(standard_wis |> filter(wis == 0))
standard_wis = standard_wis |> filter(wis != 0)
```

```{r}
standard_wis$trend <- relevel(
  factor(standard_wis$trend),
  ref = "Stable"
)

standard_wis$model_id <- relevel(
  factor(standard_wis$model_id),
  ref = "epiENGAGE-baseline"
)

standard_wis$granularity <- relevel(
  factor(standard_wis$granularity),
  ref = "state"
)
```

```{r}
LRNI <- lmer(
  log(wis) ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) + (1 | location),
  data = standard_wis
)

summary(LRNI)
```

### Testing if log(population) is statistically significant
```{r}
LRNI_pop <- lmer(
  log(wis) ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) + log(population) + (1 | location),
  data = standard_wis
)

anova(LRNI, LRNI_pop, test = 'lrt')

fit_reml <- update(LRNI_pop, REML = TRUE)

RLRsim::exactRLRT(fit_reml, seed = 123)
```

### Testing if the date random intercept is statistically significant
```{r}
LRNI_date <- lmer(
  log(wis) ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) + (1 | target_end_date) + (1 | location),
  data = standard_wis
)

anova(LRNI, LRNI_date, test = 'lrt')
```

# Estimates

```{r}
fixed_effects <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(LRNI))) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
  rename(est = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`) |>
  mutate(
    ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
    ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se,
    pct_est   = (exp(est) - 1) * 100,
    pct_lower = (exp(ci_lower) - 1) * 100,
    pct_upper = (exp(ci_upper) - 1) * 100,
    excludes_zero = ci_lower > 0 | ci_upper < 0
  )

main_effects_ci <- fixed_effects |>
  filter(!grepl(":", term)) |>
  arrange(est)

interaction_effects_ci <- fixed_effects |>
  filter(grepl(":", term)) |>
  arrange(est)

get_level <- function(terms, variable) {
  vapply(strsplit(terms, ":", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    part <- parts[startsWith(parts, variable)][1]
    level <- substring(part, nchar(variable) + 1)

    if (level == "") "per 1-unit increase" else level
  }, character(1))
}

make_ci_table <- function(variable) {
  main_effects_ci |>
    filter(startsWith(term, variable)) |>
    mutate(
      !!variable := get_level(term, variable),
      .before = 1
    ) |>
    select(-term)
}

make_interaction_ci_table <- function(variable1, variable2) {
  interaction_effects_ci |>
    filter(
      grepl(paste0("(^|:)", variable1), term),
      grepl(paste0("(^|:)", variable2), term)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      !!variable1 := get_level(term, variable1),
      !!variable2 := get_level(term, variable2),
      .before = 1
    ) |>
    select(-term)
}

model_id_ci    <- make_ci_table("model_id")
horizon_ci     <- make_ci_table("horizon")
trend_ci       <- make_ci_table("trend")
granularity_ci <- make_ci_table("granularity")
n_msa_ci       <- make_ci_table("n_msa")
pop_ratio_ci   <- make_ci_table("pop_ratio")

model_horizon_ci <- make_interaction_ci_table("model_id", "horizon")
model_trend_ci <- make_interaction_ci_table("model_id", "trend")
model_granularity_ci <- make_interaction_ci_table("model_id", "granularity")
```

## Processing
```{r}
model_base <- tibble::tibble(
  model_id = levels(model.frame(LRNI)$model_id)
) |>
  left_join(
    model_id_ci |> select(model_id, model_est = est),
    by = "model_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(model_est = coalesce(model_est, 0))

rank_models <- function(interactions) {
  model_base |>
    left_join(
      interactions |> select(model_id, interaction_est = est),
      by = "model_id"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      interaction_est = coalesce(interaction_est, 0),
      combined_est = model_est + interaction_est,
      rank = min_rank(combined_est)
    ) |>
    arrange(rank) |>
    select(rank, model_id, model_est, interaction_est, combined_est)
}

trend_increasing <- rank_models(
  model_trend_ci |> filter(trend == "Increasing")
)

trend_decreasing <- rank_models(
  model_trend_ci |> filter(trend == "Decreasing")
)

granularity_local <- rank_models(
  model_granularity_ci |> filter(granularity == "local")
)

horizon_0 <- rank_models(
  model_horizon_ci |> filter(horizon == "0")
)

horizon_1 <- rank_models(
  model_horizon_ci |> filter(horizon == "1")
)

horizon_2 <- rank_models(
  model_horizon_ci |> filter(horizon == "2")
)

horizon_3 <- rank_models(
  model_horizon_ci |> filter(horizon == "3")
)
```

```{r}
trend_increasing <- trend_increasing |>
```

```{r}
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_lower, ymax = pct_upper), width = 0.2) +
```

```{r}
lookup = read.csv("Data/lookup.csv")
location_ci = location_ci |> left_join(lookup, by = "location")

location_ci$state_level = ifelse(location_ci$state == 'state', 'state', 'not-state')

location_ci = location_ci |> 
  mutate(state = ifelse(state == 'state', as.character(location), state))

state_order = location_ci |>
  distinct(location, state, pct_est) |>
  arrange(state, desc(pct_est))

location_ci = location_ci |> 
  arrange(desc(state_level == 'state'), state, pct_est) |> 
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = state_order$location))

state_boundaries = which(diff(as.numeric(factor(state_order$state, 
                                                 levels = unique(state_order$state)))) != 0) + 0.5
```

```{r}
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_lower, ymax = pct_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(color = "firebrick", size = 5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Fixed effect (% diff on WIS)", x = "Granularity") +
  theme_bw() + 
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5)
  ) + scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("-", "-\n", x))
```
